api.notes: The element is the handle: `focus()` reaches the first thumb; `value`, `values` and the form API are on the host.
A tooltip on a disabled slider that says why; the thumbs stay focusable (aria-disabled) and values cannot change.
Conveyed by a hidden "Required" text and the indicator: `aria-required` is not defined for a slider, and a slider always has a value, so it is no constraint.
Object `{type, message?}`, or the `status-type` and `status-message` attributes. Always shown detached.
A number is px, a string a CSS length. Not reflected.

`(value: number) => string` for the bubble, the text and `aria-valuetext`. Without it the value is written with Intl in the language of the page, and `aria-valuetext` is set when that differs from the plain number.
tooltip (a bubble over the thumb), text or none.
`{value, label?}[]`; also a JSON attribute (`marks='[{"value":0,"label":"Off"}]'`). A press on a tick or its label snaps to its value.
The host submits the value under this name; a range submits two entries, the start then the end (upstream renders hidden inputs).

A number string (`"50"`, or `"20,80"` with `range`); `values` is the array and `valueAsNumber` the first number. The `value` attribute is the default (form reset restores it). Upstream is controlled with `number | [number, number]`; a range is the `range` attribute here.
Upstream onChange runs on every change during a drag and with every key, which is the native `input` event; it never fires for property writes.
The native `change` fires when a drag ends with a different value and with every key that changed it (composed, from the host).

api.reason: A-testid: a test id is the consumer's own attribute on the element.

hooks.notes: The disabled reason is a tct-tooltip around the row; the value bubble is the element's own aria-hidden bubble over each thumb, so the value is not announced twice.

hooks.reason: A thumb focused by a press draws no keyboard ring: the press marks it (`data-pointer`) until the next key or a blur.

keyboard.action: Increases by one step (in right-to-left text ArrowLeft increases and ArrowRight decreases, as on a native range).
keyboard.when: a thumb is focused, not disabled or read-only

keyboard.action: Increases or decreases by ten steps.
Goes to the minimum or the maximum (a range thumb stops at its sibling).
Moves through the thumbs of a range in order.

form.notes: Form-associated (ElementInternals): submits `name=value` (a range submits two entries, the start then the end), resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation, joins <fieldset disabled>, works with form=. There is no constraint to fail; `disabled` bars submission.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default (D-006): `value` (a number string) or `values` (an array) is a property with the `value` attribute as its default, `range` turns on two thumbs, and native `input` (during a change) and `change` (at its end) events replace the controlled `value` plus onChange/onChangeEnd. Set `value` to control it.
The host is the form participant and submits the value under `name`; no hidden inputs are rendered.

The value text is localised: without `format-value` the bubble, the text and `aria-valuetext` write the number with Intl in the language of the page (`1.234,5` in German). "Minimum value", "Maximum value" and "Required" come from the locale catalogs instead of hard-coded English.
In right-to-left text ArrowLeft increases and ArrowRight decreases a horizontal slider (its minimum is at the right), as a native range does; upstream keeps ArrowRight as increase.
In a range the group carries the label and the description and each thumb keeps its own short name; the value bubble is `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader does not hear the value twice.

The fill, the filled ticks and the thumb use the Tecton checked fill (as the checkbox and the switch do) on the `--color-track` rail; the disabled slider turns neutral grey; the thumb takes the hot-pink focus ring for the keyboard only and the value bubble is the inverted tooltip surface (tecton-astryx components.ts, slider.md).

provisional: The design frame (slider.md) shows a soft drop shadow under the thumb and a 6px track; neither is in the Tecton theme file, so the thumb has no shadow and the track is 4px like upstream.
